alerts.fires_on: a PLAY verdict, and nothing else - roughly nine draws a year
alerts.why: Everything else writes to a file or reds a workflow run, which GitHub already notifies about. An inbox that only ever says 'act' is one you still read a year later

built.freshness_gate: the collector returns success when it falls back to cached data, so a separate step asserts the expected draw is present - a silent no-op becomes a red build

hosting.deploy: GitHub Actions assuming a role over OIDC - no long-lived keys
hosting.origin: private S3, reached through Origin Access Control

built.scheduler_caveat: GitHub's cron is best-effort: on this repo it ran 13-58 minutes late through August 2026 and has drifted to 2-11 hours since. Two runs per draw plus an independent watchdog is the answer to that, not punctuality

self_healing.how: the feed serves every draw of the last ~180 days by number, so a missed collection is backfilled on the next run

workflows.does: fetch the official feed, assert it is fresh, score a Must-Be-Won, refresh this snapshot, commit the CSVs, email only on a PLAY verdict
